plugins.name: Browser
plugins.description:
Browser / browser-use plugin

Aliases: @browser, @browser-use, browser-use, Browser, in-app browser.

Use Browser, the ChatGPT in-app browser, when the user asks to open, inspect, navigate, test, click, type, or screenshot local web targets such as localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, file:// URLs, or the current in-app browser tab.

After significant frontend changes to a local app, use Browser to open the relevant local target when it is known or obvious, unless the user asks for another browser tool.

For requests like "open localhost:3000" or "open to localhost:4000", navigate the in-app browser to http://localhost:3000 or http://localhost:4000.

Do not satisfy explicit @browser or @browser-use requests with macOS `open`, shell commands, or generic web browsing unless the user asks for another browser tool or approves a fallback.

Use the data in Airtable as input to the work you’re doing in ChatGPT, like building a landing page using content you’ve organized in Airtable. Make quick updates to Airtable without leaving the chat. Airtable for ChatGPT is ideal anytime you need quick access to structured internal data to inform your conversation.

Airtable's App connects ChatGPT directly to your Airtable bases, so you can ask questions, create and update records, and analyze your data—all through conversation

plugins.name: Spotify

plugins.name: Adobe
plugins.description:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.

plugins.name: Adobe Acrobat
plugins.description: Adobe Acrobat for ChatGPT helps you transform and organize documents seamlessly. Edit, reorder, rotate, split, or merge pages; convert PDFs to other formats or redact sensitive details; and extract text from scans with OCR. You can also compress files and build organized packets in seconds. Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable PDF solutions without opening another app.

plugins.name: Consensus
plugins.description:
Consensus is the go-to MCP for academic research. Connect directly to 220M+ peer-reviewed papers to search, synthesize, and build structured research outputs from within your conversation.

Run literature reviews, build boolean search strategies, generate bibliographies, identify research gaps, and draft cited content — grounded in studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and ArXiv. Pre-built workflows handle complex tasks in minutes: systematic reviews, curriculum reading lists, grant research with novelty analysis, and clinical evidence synthesis.

Built for researchers, students, faculty, and clinicians across biomedical, social science, STEM, and all academic disciplines.

plugins.name: Shazam

plugins.name: AhaMotion
plugins.description:
AhaMotion turns complex topics into clear, animated explanations. Whether you are tackling K-12 assignments or just curious about the world, simply ask and view the concept visually.

1. Universal Concept Visualizer
Curious about “Why volcanoes erupt” or “How rain forms”? We break down general knowledge into easy-to-watch video summaries.

2. K-12 Science & Math Tutor
Visual Math Solver: Watch how functions graph and how geometric shapes transform to better understand Algebra and Geometry logic.
Science Visualization: Visualize concepts in Physics, Biology, Chemistry and related subjects.

3. General Learning Support
Turn study sessions into engaging visual stories. It acts as a tutor that draws key ideas out to support understanding and review.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect AhaMotion to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type "@AhaMotion"
Sample Prompts：
"@AhaMotion Generate a short educational video explaining how photosynthesis works."
"@AhaMotion Generate a video explaining Euler’s formula and its geometric meaning."
"@AhaMotion Create a video that explains the Pythagorean theorem for middle school students."

plugins.name: Ace Knowledge Graph
plugins.description:
Visualize files and topics with interactive Knowledge Graphs. Transform your documents into structured networks where you can simply click nodes to explain concepts and clarify relationships instantly—making complex information easy to digest.

- Interactive Exploration: Go beyond a static image. Interact with the graph to understand the underlying logic.

- Explain Concepts: Click on any node to get a clear definition and background.

- Clarify Relationships: Click on any connecting line to get an instant explanation of how two concepts are related (e.g., cause-and-effect).


Ideal Use Cases: For researchers, students, and analysts who need to visualize complex relationships in files or topics through interactive exploration.


How to Use in ChatGPT

1. Connect App: Connect Ace Knowledge Graph to ChatGPT.

2. Trigger: Type “@Ace Knowledge Graph”.

Sample prompts:

- "@Ace Knowledge Graph Research the technical principles of LLMs and generate a knowledge graph."

- "@Ace Knowledge Graph Create a knowledge graph mapping out a modern web development stack."

- "@Ace Knowledge Graph make a knowledge graph showing how cybersecurity threats and defenses relate."

plugins.name: AI Wisebase
plugins.description:
A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
Save Chat History: Save important ChatGPT chats as editable documents for future reference.

Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.

Easy Access: View and access your uploaded files and saved chats in one simple list.

2. Chat with Your Knowledge Base
Grounded Answers: Ask questions and get responses based on your saved data, complete with references to the source content. This helps ChatGPT write reports or summarize topics that matter to you.

3. Specialized Tools for Learning
Video Explanations: Transform concepts into easy-to-follow animations or video summaries.

Knowledge Graphs: Generate interactive knowledge graphs to visualize and explore your saved files and chats.

Study Aids: Turn your saved chats and files into flashcards or quizzes for review.

Document Translation: Translate PDF files and view original and translated text side-by-side.

How to Use:
Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your ChatGPT account.

Add Data: Upload your files or save chat history directly.

Trigger: Type @AI Wisebase followed by your request.

Sample Prompts:
Save History: "@AI Wisebase Save this discussion as a document."

Knowledge Base: "@AI Wisebase Draft a report using my knowledge base."

Knowledge Graph: "@AI Wisebase Generate an interactive knowledge graph for my files."

Video Learning: "@AI Wisebase Create a video explaining this concept."

Quiz/Flashcards: "@AI Wisebase Create flashcards from my saved chats."

Translate: "@AI Wisebase Translate this PDF into English."

plugins.name: Wolfram
plugins.description:
The Wolfram MCP Server transforms your AI environment into a rigorous computational powerhouse. By integrating Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, this server provides access to curated data and sophisticated algorithms. When a user submits a query, the LLM works with Wolfram to convert it into Wolfram Language for precise evaluation, and these exact results are incorporated into the response provided by the LLM.

Whether you are solving complex differential equations, analyzing chemical structures or querying real-time socioeconomic data, the MCP Server ensures your AI has the "computational brain" necessary to deliver verified, high-level technical results that can be trusted.

plugins.name: smarts.bio: AI for biology
plugins.description:
smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into ChatGPT. Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.

What you can do:
* Run sequence searches and analyses — BLAST, GC content, ORFs, domains, and more across DNA, RNA, and protein
* Call and annotate variants, align reads (WES, RNA-seq), and run quality-control and other multi-step pipelines
* Upload and manage workspace files, then open results — FASTA, BAM, VCF, PDB, CSV — in interactive viewers
* Search genes, literature, and patents alongside your analysis

Who it's for: biologists, bioinformaticians, computational biologists, and researchers who'd rather describe an analysis than wire up the tooling.

Connect your smarts.bio account to get started. Long-running jobs keep working in the background, and your files stay in your own workspace.

plugins.name: Higgsfield
plugins.description:
Create images, cinematic videos, branded assets, and social content directly in ChatGPT. Start with an idea or reference image, and use Higgsfield to turn it into a product photoshoot, a video ad, or a narrated story.

Explore creative models including Nano Banana Pro, Seedance, Kling, Seedream, and Higgsfield Soul in one conversation. Ask for a model recommendation, use your favorite, and create variations to find the right look.

With Higgsfield, you can:

• Generate images and videos from text or reference images. Create portraits, illustrations, and cinematic scenes, or bring a still photo to life.

• Create product photoshoots with studio packshots, lifestyle scenes, campaign imagery, and coordinated ad variations.

• Use Ad Multiplier to turn one existing video ad into multiple ordered variations. Replace people, products, clothing, objects, backgrounds, or selected text while preserving the original motion, timing, captions, and audio.

• Build your brand's visual identity and apply it to social graphics, banners, packaging, and mockups, keeping your logo, colors, and typography consistent.

• Make AI-generated UGC-style content: talking-head product showcases, product-only videos, unboxings, tutorials, and fashion try-ons. Create website and app promos with a virtual presenter and real screenshots.

• Produce faceless videos, narrated explainers, and illustrated stories with a consistent visual style, voiceover, and subtitles.

• Create YouTube thumbnails and Instagram covers, generate spoken narration, and add subtitles to your videos.

Describe what you want to make, review the results in chat, and build on your previous creations. From your next campaign to your next channel video, develop your content through conversation.

Connect your Higgsfield account to get started. No API key required. Generations use the same credit system as the Higgsfield platform.

plugins.name: Inductive Bio
plugins.description:
Inductive Bio’s absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models predict the chemical and pharmacokinetic properties that determine whether a molecule can become a viable drug. By surfacing these predictions directly in your conversation, scientists can evaluate compounds, triage ideas, and prioritize which molecules to synthesize, without leaving their existing workflow.

Through this MCP server, users can access Inductive Bio’s models for the physicochemical properties LogD (lipophilicity) and pKa (acid/base ionization), key drivers of solubility and permeability.

Chain tools into pipelines, batch many inputs at once, and pull back structures, results, and logs — all from chat.

plugins.name: Undermind
plugins.description:
Undermind is your AI co-researcher for the scientific literature. Ask a research question and Undermind searches the literature for you. It follows citation trails, evaluates hundreds of papers, and comes back with a ranked reading list rather than a page of keyword matches.

With Undermind you can:

- Run deep literature searches. Undermind's search agents explore a research question for a few minutes, then report back with a summary and a ranked list of relevant papers.

- Look up papers by topic, author, title, DOI, or citation relationships (papers citing or cited by a paper you know), with abstracts and citation metrics.

- Ask questions about a paper's full text, including its figures, tables, and equations, and check the answers against the source.

- Keep your work organized in workspaces with folders, starred papers, saved searches, and notes, all synced with your account at undermind.ai.

Scientists at thousands of research institutions use Undermind, from university labs to pharma R&D teams. Use it to check whether an idea is new, get oriented in an unfamiliar field, or track down the one method paper you need.

You'll need an Undermind account (free or paid) and to sign in when connecting.

plugins.name: Genomic Intelligence
plugins.description: Run six DNA sequence-analysis tasks over the hosted Genomic Intelligence API: promoter region prediction, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression, and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Give it a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a FASTA; it resolves the sequence from Ensembl and returns structured predictions. No local GPU, model weights, or API key required. For research use, not clinical or diagnostic decisions.

plugins.name: Rowan
plugins.description: Use Rowan in ChatGPT to run and manage computational chemistry and structural biology workflows. Predict molecular properties, search conformers and reaction paths, and calculate energies, structures, spectra, and electronic properties with quantum chemistry. Prepare proteins and run structure prediction, docking, molecular dynamics, and binding workflows. Calculations are saved to Rowan and available in the web app,   while existing Rowan work can be viewed and managed from ChatGPT. Track jobs, inspect results, and download supported files.

plugins.name: Canva

Bring your Canva design workflow into Codex and create, refine, and review designs through natural conversation.

Resize for social media: Adapt a design for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn in one step.
Bulk create: Generate multiple designs from spreadsheet data using a brand template.
Edit designs: Update text, media, and formatting, or reposition and resize elements.
Get design feedback: Receive structured feedback on visual hierarchy, layout, readability, consistency, and accessibility.
Implement feedback: Review comment threads and apply clear, actionable changes.
Brand check: Check colors, fonts, logo usage, and copy against your Brand Kit.
Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke Canva directly with @Canva.
Try prompts like:
- @Canva, resize this design for social media.
- @Canva, create designs from this spreadsheet using my brand template.
- @Canva, update the headline in this design.
- @Canva, review this design’s visual hierarchy and readability.
- @Canva, implement the feedback in the comment threads.
- @Canva, check this design against my Brand Kit.

Requirements: Connect your Canva account to use the plugin. Bulk Create requires an eligible Canva Enterprise plan.

Want to take a more hands-on approach? Instantly open your design in Canva’s powerful editor for the final touches.
